title: Quality Studio usage ledger entry v4
description: One agent-backed review operation. Version 4 records every billed input token: tokens.inputTokens is fresh input plus cache reads (cachedInputTokens) plus cache writes (cacheWriteInputTokens), and cost prices each at its own catalogue tariff. Before version 4 the runner dropped Claude's cache_creation_input_tokens and reported Claude input without cache reads; readers flag such entries as under-priced. promptCharacters is the rendered prompt size the review estimate scales history by.

runId.description: Provider or CLI run identifier for this individual review operation.

model.description: The model id the CLI was asked to run. The literal "runner-default" appears only together with modelSource "runner-default".

reviewRunId.description: Durable sweep/job identifier shared by every operation in one review run. Absent for standalone CLI reviews.

modelSource.description: explicit: the caller named the model. policy-default: no model was named and Quality Studio resolved the synchronized routing policy's route for the CLI and passed it explicitly. runner-default: no model was named and the policy routes nothing for the CLI, so the CLI's own default served the run and is unknown.

promptCharacters.description: Characters of the rendered prompt sent to the CLI; the preflight estimate scales matching history per prompt character.

cost.description: Estimated provider cost at the catalog price valid at the operation timestamp. total is null when no price resolved; status names the reason (resolved, unknownModel, noPriceForDate).

inputTokens.description: All input the provider billed: fresh input plus cache reads plus cache writes.

cachedInputTokens.description: Input served from the prompt cache (Claude cache_read_input_tokens, Codex cached_input_tokens).

cacheWriteInputTokens.description: Input written to the prompt cache (Claude cache_creation_input_tokens). Absent when the CLI does not report cache writes.
